installCommand: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.17.1 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: if [ -d apps/web-pwa ]; then cd apps/web-pwa; elif [ -d ../web-pwa ]; then cd ../web-pwa; fi; NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation pnpm build
devCommand: if [ -d apps/web-pwa ]; then cd apps/web-pwa; elif [ -d ../web-pwa ]; then cd ../web-pwa; fi; NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation pnpm dev
